## Description

Describe the failing operation, expected result and actual result.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest example or sequence of steps that reproduces the problem.
Include relevant configuration with credentials and device identifiers removed.

## Environment

- Library/server version or commit:
- Go version and server operating system:
- Affected package, server role or CLI command:
- Storage backend and version, if applicable:
- Apple device OS version and enrollment mode, if applicable:

## Evidence

Include relevant errors, logs or test output. Remove tokens, private keys, profiles
containing credentials and other sensitive information. Link related issues or
protocol documentation when useful.
